shared_elements: figures aligned on a common baseline facing the same direction
justification: Both surfaces show rows of profile human figures standing on a baseline within horizontal registers, several of them grasping a staff or held object, rendered in shallow relief with a comparable profile-body convention. But the depicted content otherwise diverges sharply: A is dominated by columns of sign-like script and figures before offering stands with no animals, while B is a procession centred on a large led camel and framed by rosette borders that A entirely lacks.
